candidate_single_source_timeline.outro_summary: Richie keeps trying to trade old reputation for present authority. The poker game turns disrespect into a real cost. The jacket briefly softens the exchange, then ends up on somebody else. A clearer request helps him recover at the mall, but the same refusal returns on the garbage routes. Tony holds the rules; Richie keeps arguing with the rulebook.
